articles.summary: Teradata Corporation today announced that Sumeet Arora will be joining Teradata as its Chief Product Officer on April 28, 2025.
articles.title: Teradata Appoints Sumeet Arora as Chief Product Officer

articles.summary: Teradata Corporation announced that it will release its 2025 first-quarter financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, May 6, 2025.
articles.title: Teradata Announces 2025 First Quarter Earnings Release Date
